¶1 Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem

¶2 Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim

¶3 I don't know whether we discussed about this chart or not last week. We did mysticism, of course. When we talked about it, it has two branches. One is practical mysticism and the other is considerative mysticism. That is mysticism which deals with theory of mystics about existence, about human soul and about how they see the world, in fact considerative mysticism is more like philosophy. The only difference is that they use arguments which are not used by philosophers and that is the ultimate which they provide by the way of unveiling. They see him things and then they theorize it and they try to put it in form of an argument and give us a world view about what is around us.

¶4 That is considerative mysticism. Of course, practical mysticism is the practice which mystics perform by which they can gain that unveiling knowledge, knowledge which unveils real mysticism. Now when we talk about, of course, practical mysticism, we are talking about knowledge with presence. Anything that they capture, anything that they experience, it is somehow understood by them through knowledge with presence they actually encompass. Their soul encompasses what is there. It's just like the images, which is in our soul.

¶5 You see how we understand the images which are in our mind; it is because they are present with our soul. Our soul actually encompasses them. And therefore we can say that we know them. Now when they want to know about other realities, they have to have the same experience. They have to encompass those realities by their soul, and that's the only way they can know that. Of course, things which could not be known through any other means. Now the only difficulty is that God could not be glassed in this way. They cannot encompass God. This is the only problem with mysticism, which of course poses many many difficulties on the way. And they say yes, of course the soul cannot encompass God.

¶6 However, you have to take the limitations of the soul and that is called Fanaa or annihilation so that you could be somehow unified and understand God as much as your capacity allow. That is how they actually solve this problem of understanding and finding out about God. Considerative mysticism is of course acquired knowledge because after they unveil these things they theorize it and they put it forward as theories which we read it in the books. There are lots of jargons, lots of definitions, terms, technical expressions, which of course we have to know to find out what mystics talk about. Considerative mysticism, of course could be studied by everyone and they could even say these are nonsense talked by mystics, or these makes sense or doesn't make sense.

¶7 However, practical mysticism, of course, is not something that everyone can talk about except going through some stages of practice, which the mystics of course, advise us. Now in this course inshallah we first of all, we'll have a glance at considerative mysticism or theoretical mysticism, how they see the world and how they have defined it. Of course, today unveiling they have defined all these things and then we will move on to some practical steps to see what they suggest and what they do actually to gain this knowledge. Now the first thing, the first and foremost concepts in mysticism is human soul, because this is the means to understand and to learn. Therefore, it is very important to exactly know what human soul is and how it works and what are its capacities.

¶8 Of course, mystics, you might say, exaggerate on human soul, because they say everything is inside the human soul. The whole creation is somehow corresponds somehow to some aspects of human soul. Some of the Mystics say that the verse in the Quran “Wa 'allama Aadamal asmaaa'a kullahaa: 3:31 Allah (swt) taught all the Asma to Adam. They say it means that from every name of Allah, he puts a flavour in human soul therefore human soul is lifeguard itself. And of course there is a very well-known hadith which we mentioned before that Allah created Adam after his image or according to his own image. Of course not a sensible image Allah (swt) has. This is a metaphor. Adam and all the human beings have all qualities which exist in Allah.

¶9 Of course those qualities are infinite, that qualities are very different from what is in human soul. However, there is a similarity and there is somehow a possibility of knowing Allah by referring to one's own soul. Now we will discuss this later on inshallah. So considerative mysticism, we start with human soul.

¶10 Q1. The people who do it don't necessarily believe in God? Ans: It's all about God, hereafter and human soul. Now they not necessarily have to practice like us. We talk about considerative irfan but we do not practice. So, we can understand what they say we can criticize, you can analyze. Of course, they say some of these things cannot be analyzed unless you have a sense of unveiling. No certainly not but those people who do not believe in God, but it could be understood many orientalist who do not believe in God at all, they have written about Islamic mysticism, for example. And if you go to their books, it's just a pile of information. And many obviously are rubbish.

¶11 It's just bringing information from here and there and talking and talking and talking sometimes you really get tired when you read these books because it's all bringing information. There is no knowledge it's all information and of course, everyone can talk about all these information.

¶12 Now let's look at some verses. “Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa.” 91:7 By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it. “Fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa” 91:8 And its enlightenment as to its virtues and vices. So there is something in soul which can distinguish between good and evil and this is not the power to be underestimated of course. “Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa” 91:9 truly he succeeds that purifies it. “Wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa” 91:10 And he fails that corrupts it. So, the whole story of human being in this world is about human soul, how it develops and the reason why we are here is about developing our souls in a way that we want to fashion it.

¶13 And I think these verses are very, very strong in mentioning and emphasizing the importance of human soul. Now this is of course very scary. I told you at the beginning when you recite the Quran is full of insults to the transgressors. “Wa laa takoonoo kallazeena nasul laaha fa ansaahum anfusahum; ulaaa'ika humul faasiqoon” 59:19 And do not be like those who forget Allah. So he made them forget their own souls. These are the transgressors or the faasiqoon. Well, most of us have forgotten our souls and therefore, we are categorized as transgressors. Now the reason of course, is because we have forgotten Allah and this is exactly what the mystics say. They say it is only by remembering that you can somehow divert your attention to your soul.

¶14 And this, could be actually referred from this verse that if you want to remember your soul, remember Allah, then your attention will be diverted towards your soul. And if you don’t remember Allah and you can forget your soul, you are a transgressor.

¶15 Q2. Not audible.

¶16 Ans: Not that you would necessarily be punished. I mean, if we say most people are like this and they are Muslims for example, it means that they're not going to be punished. However, they are not going to develop themselves the way they can. They do not realize the potential that they have in their soul. We have in the Quran “Wa maa yu'minu aksaru hum billaahi illaa wa hum mushrikoon” 12:106 most of the people who believe in Allah are mushrik. And this is, of course, forgiven by Allah. However, this is not about reward and punishment. It is about how we develop ourselves and what station we acquire later on with Allah. So this faasiqoon might not be punished, but still there are transgressing.

¶17 And this idea isteghfar you see, we usually do sins which we do not regard to be sins. And why we are told to do isteghfar at all time, to actually compensate for those things which we do not regard to be sins but in the eyes of Allah they are sins. And when we of course, die and wake up we see that we have been committing lots of sins which of course we do not regard them to be sins at all. The most vicious sins, the most cancer type of sins are the sins that you cannot realize that they are sins because when you cannot realize you cannot cure them. And the only way to realize it is of course by remembrance of Allah, purification of the soul and isteghfar of course, which is very important.

¶18 This is, of course, another very, very interesting verse. Of course, it is repeated in several surahs “Allazeena khasirooo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon” 6:20 those who have lost their souls will not believe. They will not believe in God because they have lost their souls because they cannot see their own soul. If you see your soul, you certainly believe in Allah because your soul is like the creation of Prophet Adam. Our body is composed of different things; it comes as a composition of different things. And you might think that okay, this is a type of evolution of matter coming, but the soul is not like that. As soon as you see the soul, you see the creator of the soul.

¶19 It cannot come about haphazardly just out of nothing and think it's there, there is a creator for it. So, those who have lost their soul, certainly they will not believe in Allah. And then all these three texts of misunderstanding and it might have been evolution or it might have come about just like this. They come because people cannot see their souls. Now let's go riwayat and see what they thought they say about human soul. One more aayah “Wa hum yanhawna 'anhu wa yan'awna 'anhu” 6:26 and they dissuade others from following him and themselves avoiding. Of course, there were some relatives of the prophet who were very, very anxious not letting anyone to follow the prophet and they themselves did not follow the prophet.

¶20 And they only bring destruction upon their own souls. “Wa iny yuhlikoona illaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon” but they only destroy their own souls, and they perceive it not. Sometimes when you read the Quran, you think that Allah never punishes anyone. Well, he talks about punishment and azaab because for justice, azaab is needed. However, most of the time it is us punishing ourselves, it is us bringing destruction to our own souls our own selves, and especially in this verse “Wa maaa asaabakum min museebatin fabimaa kasabat aydeekum” 42:30 whatever misfortune happens to you, is because of what you have done. It is the product of your own achievement. Of course, Allah protects you from many repercussions of your actions.

¶21 However, there are so many that the system of justice when it works it brings all these calamities to you. Wa maaa asaabakum min museebatin fabimaa kasabat aydeekum. Allah forgives many things that we do however when you want to destroy your soul and you have free will what Allah can do about it. Okay now let's go to hadees. Of course, this knowledge of the soul you go for Imam Ali (as). Whoever knows his soul knows his lord. Well, many many different meanings have been provided for this short statement. He who knows his soul, knows his lord. It is a two way relationship actually. You forget Allah you forget your soul, you forget your soul you forget Allah because they are very closely connected.

¶22 In fact, your soul is of course, held by Allah and we cannot see this in our bodies very easily, but in our souls we can see clearly and very brightly. It seems somehow held and kept and preserved by Allah. However, there are different stages. At one stage, you forget Allah you forget your soul. So there is one very limited stage which you return to yourself, you believe that there is a Creator for you that is a limited stage of going to one’s soul, remembering Allah. When you want to really want to know your soul you have to do all these things, you have to establish first knowledge of yourself, and then through the zikr of Allah you find full knowledge of your own soul.

¶23 Now, can anyone tell me what does this mean man? Whoever knows his soul knows his lord. So this is one meaning which the soul is actually fashioned after the image of Allah. So, it is a perfect way to know how Allah is. Soul has in itself the spirit of God as well. But the spirit of God is not god. Spirit of God is a spirit that Allah has created. Allah doesn’t have a spirit or a soul like us. So, yeah, it has some part of that spirit. So you mean that the spirit is full of knowledge of Allah.

¶48 Q14. If one sees one, so what is seeing? What half of oneself actually perceives the soul?

¶49 Ans: This is a very, very important question because mystics actually have a very, very interesting thought which has been expounded after Ibne Arabi and then in philosophy, Mulla Sadra have actually made constructive mysticism rational. He is influenced by Ibne Arabi very much. Now, they have theories which actually explain all through whatever we are going to discuss. And they say the perceiver perceives the perception. And that is why you can perceive Allah because you are his creation and actually a reflection of that. So, the soul has seen itself, it is soul that perceives the soul. And it is the most outstanding example of ilumul huzuri. The soul is so present and therefore it's perceived. So, the perceiver and perceived are the same thing actually.

Every container, when you put something in it, it will lose space accept the container of knowledge. The more you put in, the more the bigger it's become and the more it can contain and the container is human soul.

¶51 Human soul is actually unified itself with this knowledge and that's what they say when you want to know God, you have to unify yourself with God.

¶61 Now to understand the human soul we have to understand the world because the mystics say that human soul is a character sketch of our world. And human soul is aalamul asgar and the outer world is aalamul akbar. And some say the human soul is aalamul akbar and the outside world is aalamul asgar. But the right thing is that we are compact, zipped source as everything exists inside human soul. And that is why you can know them because you have identified yourself with them, they can come at your presence and therefore, of course, you are aalamul akbar as compared to the outer world. Now, what is the outer world? The cosmos so to speak, the creation of Allah.

¶62 It consists, of course, not only of the world of matter. There are other worlds corresponding to this world of matter. This universe that we see is inside another world. A Christian Cardinal went to Imam Ali (as) to post some questions and he asked in this world is akhirah inside or this world is inside akhirah? Imam Ali (as) said, certainly this world is inside akhirah. This is a very, very limited world. And akhirah actually is incompetent. “Wa inna Jahannama lamuheetatum bil kaafireen” 9:49 and indeed Hell surrounds the Unbelievers (on all sides). Now, this witness world aalamul shahadah they call it. So the material world, the world which we witness is aalamul shahadah. It is encompassed by medium world of course that world is not a material world anymore.

¶63 It is a dimension to whatever we see that matter in this world. And then it is called aalamul barzakh or aalamul mithal. Why it is called barzakh? Because barzakh is a barrier. So, they say we have the world of matter and we have the world of ruh, the world of aql. They call it arwah or uqul because they have pure intellect. There is aalamul uqul and aalamul mithal. They cannot come together. It is impossible that they can have any contact. There is a middle world; there is a medium that brings these two together. And that is aalamul mithqal or aalamul barzakh. In fact, whatever is above in the world of intellect is reflected first in the world in the medium world, which has some presence of matter.

¶64 There are dimensions, there are colours, but there is no matter and this is what you see in your sleep. You see for example, a dead or an alive person, that alive person is not in your mind, it's in your memory because sometimes you see him doing things which then it happens. So, that person is not there. There is a corresponding person to that person which is another world and that is aalamul barzakh ie the middle world. And of course when he dies he goes to that middle world because our souls cannot be without body. So we find another body in the middle world. It is not like matter, it doesn't bound like this matter. But there is still shape dimension you can see.

¶65 So, that is aalamul barzakh. And then there is the higher world which is aalamul uqul or the world of intellect in which the angels are there other and the ruh is there. Now that ruh and this matter can never come together. A medium is needed. Now when Allah says “a nafakhtu feehi mir roohee” 15:29 and breathed into Adam of My spirit. A medium was needed for that ruh who cannot come to Adam and that medium was human soul. So, human soul can very clearly go into this medium world. It is for the middle world for the time being and then it move up to aalmul uqul of course, however, this is what has brought Adam into this matter into this material world.

¶66 Now, to put it in pitch, I will explain later on as I know, this is very complicated and there are lots of questions about these different worlds actually encompassing each other and it is not material encompass of course. It has different dimension. If you suppose that it is aalamul mulk. Aalamul mithqal actually encompasses is very huge, much bigger than this material world. And many other things which is not possible in this world, it's possible in that world. Inshallah, when we die, we go and see. Who wants to go sooner and when we die we go to this world but it doesn't mean that we are alive we cannot go to this world. It is possible and the reason this possible is because when we sleep, our souls can really go there and see thing.

So, in fact, we do not see the very happening of that thing, which takes place in this world in the future, you see the correspondence of it in that world, which of course has no time. And you can see now and if this is the case, then when we go into this world, the concept of time changes for us. And many things that you hear in hades that for example, on the very moment of death many things happen to a person just in the blink of an eye, and you cannot imagine how this is possible all these things, all these people and angels coming and talking, telling things, discussion is because the concept of time is changed here.

And usually everything we're thinking about we're looking at everything is drowning out this perception. And when we sleep is not around anymore, you can start proceeding things because nothing else is blocking. The attention of the soul to the body, you see our body is yearning for our soul and especially when we become older it becomes more.

In fact, when we die the soul doesn't leave the body, the soul dumps the body. It’s just scare and go, when the time comes; the soul can just dump the body and go.

It would have left but well Allah has made it a prisoner in this body until an appointed time okay. Now when we die we go to that world because there is no attachment with the body. Now, if someone can while they are awake or alive can lessen that attachment. They can divert the attention of the soul from the body through something else from this material world to the high world. Can they also pass and go to this world of barzakh or this middle world?

¶71 When we divert our attention to Allah and we become unaware of our bodies then we can touch that barzakh and we can see things there exactly the same way you see things in sleep, we see things while we are awake and they say why is it so stressful? Don't you see it in your sleep? You see it when you are awake and in fact when we are awake, we are much more diverted from our body than while we are asleep and the more they can divert the attention from the body more clearly they can see and this of course comes through muraqabah, we can discuss later on how we can detach ourselves from the body and bodily needs.

It’s only possible for Immah to do whenever they want. For mystics it is just opportunity given by Allah. More clearly I can see things that of course people see in their dreams for example you see an imam okay, what you think? You have never seen an imam, I mean for example you see Imam Hussain in your dream okay, how can you say that he is Imam Hussain?

¶73 You have never seen him. How can you say?

¶74 For ilmul huzuri you have to have a prior knowledge about it, isn't it? You perceive them with your soul. You know, there are no veils to misguide you to lie to you to teach you to do anything like that. So no veils there. Yeah, actually, you know many things there I mean, as you see this, here and you notice the table or you see a person here and you see that he's your friend for example, when you go to that world, in that world, actually our knowledge is very different, that our introduction which goes far to even we know. Now when we see for example, Imam Hussain (as) what is exactly he? Now let’s keep Imam Hussain aside.

¶75 This world of aalamul mithqal, mithqal means image. Aalamul mithqal is what we see in this world.

¶76 You can’t come back into your body but your body can see things happening depending on your situation. But when you're alive, you do the same thing. I don't mean that your soul comes out of the body. I just want attention. You take your attention from your body to something else. I don't mean that your soul comes out from your body. You just divert your attention from your body. Now, some mystics try to do this and they try to mention the name of Allah and have some movement in a way that you recite this for 15 minutes you realize this, completely your mind goes out with regards to your mind. This cynical attitude takes you out of your mind and then you cannot put attention on whatever is going on.

¶77 And then when we complement it with zikr then they say that when we say this zikr continuously then we get a flavour of what this name is. Okay? I don't know whether they forget. We don't have such a practice after immah but this is what they say. They say that we can somehow divert the attention of the soul from the body to that name, that name of Allah. Okay. And then they say we come to a knowledge about it, we identify with that name.

¶78 Q16. So now can we bring the attention to another dimension with this ability to detect? Can you see your presences there as well? So if you are present here and you have achieved this status of where you can Allah has given you the will because there may be a purpose. I’m saying that you're not moving from this word to aalamul barzakh. You are moving from this word but outside your body. It's not that they are dead or the damage. We are physically present here yet my mind is present somewhere else and yet I can be seen present in this world.

¶79 Ans: It's not that your body is seen there. It is an image which comes through perception. Mystics actually put very much stress on this aayah “fa arsalnaaa ilaihaa roohanaa fatamassala lahaa basharan” 19:17 the image of a person came to Maryam mind. In fact, that image could not be seen by anyone. Now when prophet saw Jabriel and others didn’t see him? It was the image of the Jabriel. And it was perceived inside of that soul rather than being outside However, the prophet saw him outside okay, but it was a perception of image.

¶80 Q17. Not audible.

¶81 Ans: No, of course, perception of immah and people it depends, it might be an illusion. Of course, we have in riwayat that prophet and immah could not have illusion when they see them. However other things could be illusions, they might be wrong images, okay, depending on. You see, when we have lots of these illusions in our dreams, I mean, your soul, when it's wrong is this aalamul mithqal comes to some meaning for which he cannot find an image in his own mind. And therefore, it tries to attach it to something which is already there. Now, for example, we see that in future it is going to be given to you knowledge, for example. It cannot find that image for knowledge.

¶82 What is knowledge? Knowledge purifies, then he fixes an image of an ocean. And when you dream, you see that, for example, you are swimming in an ocean. And that's why then you go to person and you say that I saw these images, and they say this is what correspondence to reality. It is a whole idea of interpretation of dream. And, for example, a dream of seven thin cows which ate seven fat cows. This was interpreted by Prophet Yusuf as there are going to be seven years of good rain and cultivation and then seven years of famine. He couldn't find an image for this. How we should interpret? How could it happen? He was a very quick type of prophet I mean, if you see you can find images for famine and other images okay but since the mind is actually roaming, it tries to to take an image from the memory, from the soul of images and it takes an image.

¶83 If that person is the a silly person takes an image which is very weird and then the interpreter cannot interpret and this is what happened to Firaun. He had taken wrong images and therefore no interpreter could interpret and he had just taken from here and there. We cannot actually interpret however if someone is more knowledgeable in this like Prophet Yusuf. He could interpret. He could say okay the image actually corresponds to famine and cultivation.

¶84 Okay, so aalamul mithqal is a world of images. Of course when we die and go to the other world which has an image, we don't have body but we have image and that's why it's called the middle word. There are images but there are no bodies. When we go to the higher world of course then there are no images there. However, we cannot go there ever without a body with image or something like that even when we are in jannah we have images or anywhere. However our soul can go to that imageless world of arwah and of course world Allah is magical about all these things. Now, aalamul mithqal is of course encompassed by a bigger world which is all about aalamul uqul.

¶85 These are angels and arwah and actually pure intellect. Your intellect is something which has no matter whatsoever and they realize they live they are living and they have knowledge. This is why they are called pure intellect okay. And of course, all these encompass by another world, which is the kursi of Allah. “wasi'a Kursiyyuhus samaawaati wal arda” 2:255 His Throne is extend over the heavens and the earth. What kursi encompasses and we have in hades that all these worlds that you see here when you compare it kursi of Allah is like a small ring. And then kursi is encompassed by arsh of Allah and they say you compare the kursi to the arsh it is like a small ring.

¶86 And then arsh of course, is encompassed by jabbarut of Allah. Well, we cannot imagine this arsh and jabbarut. Even this universe we cannot know I mean, they just imagine the distance between us and other stars to see how huge this aalmul mulk is and how aalmul mithqal would be. The mystics say that human soul has correspondence with all these three worlds. We have an existence here in this world, me and you are walking here have the correspondence in aalamul mithqal and that why we can see each other there. And when we die, we go there actually and our soul can actually be present there as well. And that's me and you, much bigger than this, me and you here, much, much bigger.

¶87 It's only by reflection inside that we can find the hugeness of our soul. And then there's correspondence of that me and you in aalamul uqul. And say, for example, for our prophet, the first thing that Allah created was noor. That was the correspondence thing of the Prophet in aalamul uqul which is, of course, the most elegant creation of Allah. In that world of course, you are very huge and you can expand more and more by gaining knowledge, remember this word of Imam Ali (as) every container uses space and gets full but for the container of knowledge is the soul, the more you put in the more big it becomes and that's why human soul is limitless.

¶88 Q18.Not audible

¶89 Ans: The world of perfect form actually, yes, that is something put forward by Plato and it corresponds to aalamul mithqal. Mithqal is image and soul and in fact, Plato said that for everything that you see in this world is a perfect copy in aalamul mithqal. And that is why you cannot see. Actually when you see anything, you cannot grasp in your mind, the only thing is that you correspond this to something which already exists in aalamul mithqal.

¶90 Q19. Not audible.

¶91 Ans: However, we shouldn't actually underestimate our body as well, you see, our body is somehow we materialize on our soul and that's why we look different because our souls are different and we look different. And even after we use body, the images that we have, in the other world are like this and that’s why we can recognize it. Even on the dead of judgement the ruh comes back. You can recognize each other as well. And that's because the soul and body are so linked to each other that even the image of the soul in the other world is like the image of the body in this world. Of course, it might get better, brighter, or it might get worse.

¶92 But still you can realize that this body belongs to that soul.

¶93 Q20. Whenever there was a communication between prophet and Allah it was through Jibreal. How does Allah communicate with Jibreal?

¶94 Ans: It is through perception and knowledge actually being induced to Jibreal or something like that.

¶95 Q21. You described how human beings soul could communicate with aimmah in aalamul mithqal. But can be done aalamul uqul?

¶96 Ans: That's very difficult. That's almost impossible in this world. It's only happens to prophet and imams. For mystics they usually cannot go beyond aalamul mithqal. It's much harder and it only happens after death. While you're in this body it is very difficult, usually doesn't happen.

¶97 Wa sallahu ala mohammadin wa aale hittahereen.
